name: Arctic Comic Con
blurb: Alaska's largest comic book and pop-culture convention, held each spring at the Dena'ina Center in Anchorage.

picks: Voice of Bulbasaur and others in Pokemon

editions.evidence: Homepage countdown text: 'APRIL 24 & APRIL 25, 2027 DENA'INA CENTER - ANCHORAGE, ALASKA'; guests page banner: 'TARA SANDS Lends us her voice at ARCTIC COMIC CON 2027!'

notes: Guests page shows Lou Diamond Phillips and Tara Sands above the fold as newly announced (image uploads dated Sept/Oct 2026, and Tara Sands' own card says 'at ARCTIC COMIC CON 2027'); only these 2 belong to the 2027-04-24 edition. The rest of the page is an explicit year-tabbed archive ('2026', '2025', '2024', 'Some of our previous special guests') of past-show lineups (e.g. Ron Perlman, Billy West, Laz Alonso under the '2026' tab are last year's already-past April 2026 show, confirmed by their image upload dates of Nov 2025-Mar 2026) and are correctly excluded. Cover uses the current ACCA logo (og image is an older 2022 logo version); no distinct key-art banner for the 2027 show was found yet.
